name: Glimmer Ore
description: Soft, shiny ore. Used to refine level 1 weapons.

name: Bright Ore
description: Ore with a steady inner light. Used to refine level 2 weapons.

name: Enriched Starsteel
description: Starsteel purified in moonlight. Refines a weapon of any level with better odds above the safe limit.

name: Enriched Moonstone
description: Moonstone purified in starlight. Refines armor with better odds above the safe limit.

name: Flame Stone
description: A stone that is always warm. Forged into a weapon, it gives the weapon the fire element.

name: Frost Stone
description: A stone rimed with frost. Forged into a weapon, it gives the weapon the water element.

name: Gale Stone
description: A stone that hums in the wind. Forged into a weapon, it gives the weapon the wind element.

name: Terra Stone
description: A heavy stone full of life. Forged into a weapon, it gives the weapon the earth element.

name: Star Crumb
description: A fragment of a fallen star. Up to three can be forged into a weapon for bonus ATK.

name: Ember Oil
description: Coats your weapon: attacks become fire for 10 minutes.

name: Frost Oil
description: Coats your weapon: attacks become water for 10 minutes.

name: Gale Oil
description: Coats your weapon: attacks become wind for 10 minutes.

name: Terra Oil
description: Coats your weapon: attacks become earth for 10 minutes.

name: Blessed Water
description: Coats your weapon: attacks become holy for 10 minutes.

name: Wraith Oil
description: Coats your weapon: attacks become ghost for 10 minutes.
